items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: One of them was named... the trumpet player was named, his name was, he had a French name, Val San.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the fellows in the band?

One of them was named, the banjo player was named Walter Lewis, and the drum player was named Broussard. And the trumpet player was named, his name was, he had a French name, Val San. I just remember his first name now, but we used to call him Black Eagle, it was real dark. And I think he died just some years ago in...
They called him the... They called him Black Eagle. That's when the band got the name, I don't know.

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: that's a little band I played with over there

ctx.x: Who was that foul singer over there, Black Eagle?
Oh, Black Eagle, well he's still, I think someone told me he's still around there yet. He was pretty good, that's a little band I played with over there.
You say he's in Mandeville? He's in Mandeville now, yes.
